meaning.en: Bein capable for use or action.
meaning.vi: Bein có khả năng sử dụng hoặc hành động.

meaning.en: Simple past tense and past participle of enable.
meaning.vi: Quá khứ đơn và quá khứ phân từ của enable.

meaning_vi: làm cho có thể (làm gì), làm cho có khả năng (làm gì)

sentences.en: More than once he had enabled Dolokhov to escape when pursued.
sentences.vi: Hơn một lần anh ta đã tạo điều kiện cho Dolokhov trốn thoát khi bị truy đuổi.

sentences.en: The demon's power enabled me to save a life today.
sentences.vi: Sức mạnh của quỷ đã giúp tôi cứu được một mạng người ngày hôm nay.

sentences.en: The peace of Tilsit (July 7, 1807) enabled Napoleon to press on his projects for securing the command of the Mediterranean, thenceforth a fundamental axiom of his policy.

sentences.en: It simply has been enabled by technology combined with prosperity compounded over time.

sentences.en: The culture developed in the West during the 13th century was not only permitted to develop by the protection of the Crusades, it grew upon materials which the Crusades enabled it to import from the East.

sentences.en: The former was the driving force which made the First Crusade successful, where later Crusades, without its stimulus, for the most part failed; the latter was the one staunch ally which alone enabled Baldwin I.

sentences.en: This innate power of variation has enabled the florist to obtain, and ultimately to "fix," so many remarkable varieties.

sentences.en: He had as a nucleus but few regular troops, but the energy of the military and civil authorities enabled his force to be augmented by national guards, &c., to 17,600 men.
